en: {player}! You woke that Snorlax? I heard it snoring from the coast. I took the long way round.
The Gym here is at the very top of the town. Its Leader climbs rock walls, and his Pokémon are as hard as the cliffs.
Before you go up, let's see what you've learned since Santalune.
You're climbing faster than I am. Good. Then I know who I'm racing.
Close. Very close. Rock-type Pokémon won't be as kind to you as I was, though.
Water and Grass get the better of stone, they say. Good luck with the climb.
The Gym is up the steps, right at the top.
